format:
  html:
    toc: true
    number-sections: false
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
library(targets)
tar_config_set(store = file.path("..", "_targets"))
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
if (requireNamespace("exdyn.sandbox", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(exdyn.sandbox)
} else if (requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pkgload::load_all(path = normalizePath(".."), export_all = FALSE, helpers = FALSE, attach_testthat = FALSE)
} else {
  stop("Package exdyn.sandbox not available and pkgload not installed.")
}

real_cfg <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path("..", "config", "realdata.yaml"))
real_grid <- tar_read(real_grid)
real_arrivals_raw <- tar_read(real_arrivals_raw)
real_arrivals_smooth <- tar_read(real_arrivals_smooth)
real_cells <- tar_read(real_cells)
real_qc <- tar_read(real_qc)
real_gbif_clean <- tar_read(real_gbif_clean)
```

## Data summary

- GBIF records fetched: **`r nrow(real_gbif_clean)`**
- Time span: **`r min(real_gbif_clean$year)`** – **`r max(real_gbif_clean$year)`**
- Grid cells (10 km): **`r nrow(real_grid)`**
- Cells with smoothed arrivals: **`r sum(!is.na(real_arrivals_smooth$arrival_year_smooth))`**

```{r occurrence-table}
head(real_gbif_clean) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Sample of cleaned GBIF occurrences")
```

## Occurrence density

```{r density-map}
exdyn_occ_density_map(real_grid, real_cells, "Mink occurrence density")
```

## Arrival maps

```{r arrival-maps}
exdyn_plot_arrival_map(real_grid, mutate(real_arrivals_raw, arrival_year_smooth = arrival_year_raw),
                       "Arrival year (raw criteria)")
```

```{r arrival-map-smooth}
exdyn_plot_arrival_map(real_grid, real_arrivals_smooth,
                       "Arrival year (smoothed neighbourhood fill)")
```

## QC summary

```{r qc-table}
tibble::enframe(real_qc, name = "Metric", value = "Value") %>%
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Metric", "Value"), caption = "Quality control metrics")
```

## Parameter settings

```{r cfg-print}
str(real_cfg$arrival)
```
